task.prompt: Slug normalization does not follow the documented contract. The contract is used in more than one part of this project. Fix every implementation site without changing tests or public exports.

checks.command: node --input-type=module -e "const [{normalizeSlug: projectSlug}, {normalizeSlug: userSlug}] = await Promise.all([import('./src/projects/normalize.js'), import('./src/users/normalize.js')]); const cases = [['  Alpha   Beta  ', 'alpha-beta'], ['ONE\tTWO\nTHREE', 'one-two-three'], ['single', 'single']]; for (const normalize of [projectSlug, userSlug]) for (const [input, want] of cases) { const got = normalize(input); if (got !== want) { console.error(JSON.stringify({input, got, want})); process.exit(1); } }"
